USB Most changes, 2026-11-05:
- Cargo.toml and Cargo.toml.orig: rsa =0.10.0-rc.18 -> =0.10.0-rc.20;
  pkcs1 =0.8.0-rc.4 -> =0.8.0, matching the new RSA encoding API.
- src/keys/format/pkcs8.rs: use the RsaPrivateKeyRef alias introduced by
  pkcs1 0.8 for the same borrowed DER decoder (one type-name adaptation).
- Omitted the package's unused standalone Cargo.lock. The application root
  Cargo.lock is authoritative. All other upstream Rust sources are unchanged.
- Removed trailing spaces on three README.md lines (no text change).
- Added this provenance file and the standard Apache license text.

The root workspace pins RustCrypto/SSH commit
beb2d1a4a5cbda803dad5610a803517756c4ee7f, which implements upstream's
RSA rc.20 API adaptation (https://github.com/RustCrypto/SSH/pull/611).
RSA rc.20 includes RustCrypto/RSA#739 and #749 (blinding/implicit rejection).
This integration is not a replacement cryptographic implementation or an
independent security audit. The RustSec database may still report
RUSTSEC-2023-0071 until its affected-version metadata is updated; do not hide it.

Remove this local dependency adaptation when an upstream russh release supports
the required RSA version, after the SSH/Windows/Android regression gates pass.
